experiment: Stage 3.2 — per-class targeted ablation of layer-3 noetic directions on Pythia-160M
sanity_gate_per_class_self_kept_rates: see stdout — class c's pred rate on true_y==c after ablating only direction c. Should drop below 0.5 for the ablation to be considered specific to that class.
verdict_text: Diagonal and off-diagonal first_token_changed rates are indistinguishable (0.079 vs 0.062). Ablating one class's direction is no more disruptive to its own class's prompts than to other classes' prompts. The Stage 3.1 behavioural effect is real but not class-specific at layer 3 — the directions point at a shared 'noetic-shaped' axis, not at distinct per-class features. This bounds the mechanistic claim sharply.
